lost_requests_root_causes: Voice notes are never written onto the production board: 37 of 37 voice-note edit requests were lost, compared with 2 of 39 by email and 3 of 28 by WhatsApp text.

On 2026-06-04 Axeom itself told every client by WhatsApp broadcast to "just send edit notes as a voice note". Voice-note requests went from 2 in May to 11 in June, and the monthly lost rate went from 3/12 (25%) to 15/23 (65%).
Instagram DMs are not watched as a place where edit notes arrive: 6 of 6 were lost.
Vague references ("the one we shot last week") are not resolved to a video: 6 of 9 lost. The board has no request log, just one note field per video, so nobody checks which video was meant.

There is no single inbox and no confirmation back to the client. Requests live in 5 channels, only email and WhatsApp text get copied to the board by hand, and clients only find out a note was missed when the video comes back wrong (28 "did anyone see my message / still not fixed" follow-ups).

evidence: 2026-09-29 website form: "We would like to talk about our contract and whether we continue."
2026-10-02 email: "Following up. We need to talk about the contract this week."
5 edit requests never reached the board (2 in the last 45 days)
5 "did anyone see my message / still not fixed" follow-ups
No reply from us on record to: 2026-09-29, 2026-10-02

A standing instruction (2026-09-03, voice note: say "Magnolia Chiropractic", not "Magnolia Chiro") was missed; on 2026-09-08 Trent wrote "Not happy". Our own production board still labels their videos "Magnolia Chiro".
Worth $2,500/month retainer, one of our 4 retainer clients (Greenway already left in July for the same reason: "my notes keep getting missed").

best_marketing_channel.why: Referrals close 9 of 9 leads (every other channel closes 20-38%) and cost nothing we can see, so they make the most profit per lead: $1751 vs $1107 for Website form, the next best (Instagram $1063). Instagram has the highest profit per client ($4466) only because two of its clients are $2,500 retainers; one (Greenway) already left and the other (Magnolia) is about to.
